snippet.title: Jewel Rotation - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Jewel Rotation is a fun and addictive puzzle game.

The board consists of four side-to-side layers filled with sparkling jewels. You have a quota to clear a number of specific kinds of jewels. You clear jewels by rotating the layers so that four of the same jewels line up. When you get a four of a kind, those jewels vanish and are replaced by more jewels. If you meet your jewel quota, you go to the next level for a tougher puzzle. You also have a time limit, so you better get those jewels out of there quickly!

Developed by Sprakelsoft
Also released on iOS and Nintendo Switch
